title: Do it for them!

content: If at any time in your life, you feel that you’re not going to reach a certain goal, that all chances of success are nearly gone, that all you can do is just sit and feel sad about it…just wait for a moment, and think of those people who trusted you to do it, even once, or even if its just one person, if there are people who care about you and want you to be strong and just do your best…then just do it, put in all you’ve got, if you can’t do it for yourself, just do it for them!
